8 eggs

¼ cup of sweetener
1 teaspoon of cinnamon 
(OPTIONAL 1/4 c coconut flour to prevent it collapsing)
Butter for frying 
Keto Syrup - brown sugar & butter &  maple extract

Directions:
Preheat oven to 350
Melt butter and cream cheese
In a food processor or juicer add in eggs, flavoring, sweetener, baking powder, and  GENTLY melted butter and cream cheese 
Mix well
Pour in prepared smaller loaf pan with parchment 
Baked for 20 to 25 minutes
Allow to cool to touch and slice 1" THICK.  Heat skillet with butter & fry on both sides
Serve with syrup and or whipped cream - DELICIOUS
